description: Who may access and use the content. Used when a license differs by the type of agent or organization making the request.

tokens.description: An individual natural person for personal, non-commercial use.
tokens.notes: Does not cover business, institutional, or commercial use by that individual. If the individual acts as an agent for a commercial entity, the commercial_entity token applies instead.

tokens.description: An academic or research institution: university, research lab, publicly-funded scientific body.
tokens.notes: Typically non-profit, though some academic institutions operate commercial subsidiaries. For private research companies, use commercial_entity. Often combined with research function restriction.

tokens.description: A formally registered non-profit organization: NGO, charity, foundation, public-interest body.
tokens.notes: Broader than academic. Requires formal non-profit status under applicable law. A social enterprise or benefit corporation does not qualify unless it holds non-profit registration. critical=true recommended when the distinction is legally material.

tokens.description: A news, journalism, or editorial media organization producing original news content.
tokens.notes: Used in editorial-only stock media licenses that permit news illustration while prohibiting advertising use. critical=true strongly recommended. Does not cover aggregators, newsletter platforms, or content syndication services unless those also produce original journalism.

tokens.description: A licensed broadcast entity operating terrestrial, cable, or satellite television or radio.
tokens.notes: Distinct from streaming services. Requires a formal broadcast license in the jurisdiction of operation. Does not cover IPTV-only services or online-only video publishers (those use stream function, not broadcast).

Catch-all for commercial use when the specific organization type is not material to the license. Use more specific tokens (news_publisher, broadcaster) when the license distinguishes between commercial organization types.
